$comment: Tool Policy (proposed C41) seed rows: one row per MCP tool, from document 24, sections 2.2, 2.3 and 6.1, and tools.json. C41 is still a proposal (document 20, section 2.10). The config schema validates this file as a preset entity file. It joins a preset only when C41 is adopted.

allowedRoleKeys: the roles of tools.json defaultRoles.roleKeys. Where the default is a relation, the roles come from the document 24, section 2.2 table: any role and anyone signed in give all 15 human roles; an owner relation gives application-owner; a record relation gives the roles with W in that toolset. The engine still checks the relation, as each row's description says. C41 has no column for a relation, so requiresOwnerRole stays false: no tool needs every caller to own the application.
maxAiState: the furthest AI write state of the tool in tools.json. Configuration can only tighten it. The engine contract caps it whatever this row says.
callsPerPersonPerHour is left out: document 24 gives no default. A missing value means no per-person limit until an adopter sets one.

WORKING DEFAULT (open design question 9). aiMaySubmit is yes for intake requests, change requests, decisions and configuration drafts on submit_record, and for review requests on request_architecture_review.
WORKING DEFAULT (open design question 8). submit_record: the engine accepts without an approval request only for the locked list.
WORKING DEFAULT (open design question 4). propose_configuration_change: a person accepts the exact diff on the decision page.
WORKING DEFAULT (open design question 7). record_deployment: AI-only code approvals never count as authorization.
WORKING DEFAULT (open design question 12). No row names a workload role. deployment-recorder and approval-writer call no MCP tool; pipelines use the record endpoint under a Workload Grant (C42).
Rows change like any configuration row: through a configuration draft and an accepted decision. No tool writes them.

D-38. answer-approval: maxAiState is read-only, because no AI client is ever served answer_approval (its contract serves only the person entry). Its relation, asked-approver, gives all 15 human roles: an approval rule may ask any role, and the engine checks that the person is the one the approval request asks.

Tools 53 to 59 (get-decision, list-approvals, list-intake-requests, get-intake-request, list-reviews, list-portfolios, list-owner-assignments) are reads added for the web app's screens (D-36). Any role reads them: all 15 human roles, Max AI State read-only. The read visibility settings still filter their rows.

Tool 60 (score-intake-request) records the PMO's demand fields, as reported (pmo and platform-admin). Tool 61 (find-people) is a read for the pickers: any role, Max AI State read-only (document 24, B24-9).

Tools 65 to 74 (document 24, B24-11): get-audit-trail reads the audit entries (platform-admin and auditor only, document 26, section 5.3); get-evidence, get-ai-activity, get-tier-assessment, list-documents and list-deployment-targets are reads for any role; list-gap-check-runs follows list-claims; save-dependency writes as reported (owner of the app, architect, platform-admin); save-deployment-target (platform-admin) and save-portfolio (platform-admin, pmo) are served only to a person, so their maxAiState is read-only.

The data taxonomy (D-37, settled by D-41, question 4) adds the human role data-governance-lead: it appoints the owners of top-level data domains, keeps data locations and mappings, and sees every data gap. It reads what any role reads; it may propose an owner change (the engine still checks the owner relation for an application, and the data domain subject comes with the data tools); and, like the data owner, it may propose, submit and withdraw a decision and save a link. The data tools of docs/architecture/data-taxonomy.md, numbered 76 to 86, bring their own rows.

Tools 87 to 94 (document 24, B24-18): list-configuration-changes, get-configuration-draft, get-role-access and list-guidelines are reads of configuration rows, which all roles read; get-measures and list-agents are reads for any role; get-admin-status is for the platform admin, the configuration admin and the auditor; request-security-review writes a review request as request-architecture-review does (WORKING DEFAULT, open design question 9: aiMaySubmit is yes for review requests).
Tools 97 and 98 (document 24, B24-21): list-data-uses and list-data-mappings are reads of the data rows across domains, for any role, Max AI State read-only, like get-data-domain.

Tools 99 to 102 (document 24, B24-22): import-data-taxonomy writes a configuration draft like propose-configuration-change (configuration-admin, Max AI State candidate); renew-approval-request and retry-approval-card are served only to a person, so their maxAiState is read-only, and the engine checks the proposer or platform admin for the first; get-demo-freshness is a read for any role, served only on a demo install.

rows.label: Who am I
rows.description: Who am I here, and what may I do. Default roles: Anyone signed in. The server answers it for every signed-in caller, also one with no product role.

rows.label: Get my queue
rows.description: What needs me. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Get role holders
rows.description: Who is on the change board. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Find people
rows.description: Find people by name among the people the product knows, for the pickers. Default roles: Any role. No leave date and no erased person is returned.

rows.label: Find records
rows.description: Find a record by its number, such as DEC-0123, for the global search. Default roles: Any role. Rows the caller may not read are never found.

rows.label: List teams
rows.description: Which teams and committees there are, the roles each holds, its members count and what waits on it. Default roles: Any role. Members are read live from Entra as the person, or from the demo personas on a demo install, and never stored.

rows.label: Get team
rows.description: One team or committee: its members, roles, the decision types it answers, its applications and owner assignments, what waits on it now, its recent answers and its owner gaps. Default roles: Any role. Members are read live and never stored.

rows.label: Find applications
rows.description: Which apps match. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Get application owners
rows.description: Who owns this app. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Get application card
rows.description: Everything about this app, in one card. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Get dependency impact
rows.description: What breaks if it retires. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Get portfolio summary
rows.description: How does the portfolio look, and which apps lack an owner. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Get requirements
rows.description: What does my tier need. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Check duplicates
rows.description: Does this already exist. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Get tier questions
rows.description: Which questions set the tier. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Save intake draft
rows.description: Start or edit an intake request. Default roles: requester, maker, application-owner, pmo, ai-lead, platform-admin.

rows.label: Answer tier questions
rows.description: Which tier do my answers suggest. Default roles: Requester of the intake, owner of the app. The engine also checks the caller is the requester of the intake request, or an owner of the subject application.

rows.label: Save application draft
rows.description: Register an app already built. Default roles: requester, maker, application-owner, ai-lead, platform-admin.

rows.label: Link component
rows.description: This app, function or agent belongs to my app; it moved; it is gone. Default roles: Owner of the app, platform-admin. A caller without the role platform-admin must also be an owner of the subject application. The engine checks it.

rows.label: Propose owner change
rows.description: Hand over or add an owner of an application, a data domain or a data location. Default roles: Owner of the app, ai-lead (agents), platform-admin; for a data domain, its effective data owner, data-governance-lead and platform-admin; for a data location, its technical owner, data-governance-lead and platform-admin. A caller without the role ai-lead or platform-admin must also be an owner of the subject application. The engine checks it.

rows.label: Save decision proposal
rows.description: Record a decision for acceptance. Default roles: Holders of R, A or C for the decision type (C31). The engine also checks the caller is a holder of the R, A or C letter for the decision type in the decision's scope (C31).

rows.label: Submit record
rows.description: Send it for approval. Default roles: The record's requester or creator. The engine also checks the caller is the requester or creator of the record.

rows.label: Withdraw record
rows.description: Take it back. Default roles: The record's requester or creator. The engine also checks the caller is the requester or creator of the record.

rows.label: Get decision log
rows.description: What was decided, by whom, and why. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Get approval status
rows.description: Who still has to approve. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Save change request draft
rows.description: Start or edit a change request. Default roles: Owner of the app, maker, change-manager. A caller without the role maker or change-manager must also be an owner of the subject application. The engine checks it.

rows.label: Check standard change
rows.description: Does this change fit a pre-approved model. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Get change request
rows.description: Where is this change. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Get change schedule
rows.description: What is planned, where, when. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Record change result
rows.description: How did the change end. Default roles: Owner of the app, change-manager. A caller without the role change-manager must also be an owner of the subject application. The engine checks it.

rows.label: Complete change
rows.description: This change is done. Default roles: Owner of the app, change-manager. A caller without the role change-manager must also be an owner of the subject application. Served only to a person in the product's web app, never to an AI client. Only an authorized change closes, with its result.

rows.label: Record deployment
rows.description: This version reached this target. Default roles: Owner of the app, maker, change-manager. A caller without the role maker or change-manager must also be an owner of the subject application. The engine checks it.

rows.label: Get deployments
rows.description: What runs where. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Map pipeline
rows.description: This pipeline deploys this app to these targets. Default roles: Owner of the app (technical), platform-admin. A caller without the role platform-admin must also be a technical owner of the subject application. The engine checks it.

rows.label: Get pipeline map
rows.description: Which pipelines deploy this app. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Check change approval
rows.description: Does this change have the approvals its policy requires. Default roles: Any role (preview); GateCheck.Ask app role on the record endpoint. App-only callers on the record endpoint need the app role GateCheck.Ask. Release Later, so it ships disabled.

rows.label: Get documentation status
rows.description: What documentation is missing or stale for my app. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Record document link
rows.description: Here is the page, and its status. Default roles: Owner of the app, document owner. The engine also checks the caller is an owner of the subject application, or the document owner.

rows.label: Confirm document checked
rows.description: Is this document still true. Default roles: Owner of the app, document owner. The engine also checks the caller is an owner of the subject application, or the document owner.

rows.label: Run gap check
rows.description: What is running that is not in the register. Default roles: platform-admin, plus an inventory Entra role. The caller also needs an Entra role that can query the inventory.

rows.label: Compare inventory list
rows.description: Compare this list I fetched myself. Default roles: platform-admin.

rows.label: List claims
rows.description: What is waiting to be claimed. Default roles: maker, application-owner, ai-lead, pmo, platform-admin, auditor.

rows.label: Claim resource
rows.description: That one is mine. Default roles: maker, application-owner, ai-lead, platform-admin. A claim for a new application starts a draft intake request; a claim on an existing application by someone who holds no owner role submits an ownership decision for its owners (an AI client's claim leaves it proposed for the person to submit).

rows.label: Dismiss claim
rows.description: That one is not a business application. Default roles: platform-admin.

rows.label: Get configuration
rows.description: What rules are in force, and what changed. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: List presets
rows.description: Which ready-made configurations exist. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Propose configuration change
rows.description: Change the rules the way the admin said. Default roles: configuration-admin.

rows.label: Export configuration
rows.description: Give me the configuration as files. Default roles: configuration-admin, platform-admin, auditor.

rows.label: Check role bindings
rows.description: Is every role held only through its group, or a recorded workload grant. Default roles: platform-admin.

rows.label: Save link
rows.description: Link this work item or this evidence. Default roles: Owner of the subject's app, change-manager, pmo; evidence on records the caller can write. A caller without the role change-manager or pmo must also be an owner of the application of the linked record, or for evidence, a person who may write the record the evidence supports. The engine checks it.

rows.label: Record owner leave
rows.description: This owner leaves on this date. Default roles: The leaving person (any role), an owner of an app the person owns, platform-admin. A caller without the role platform-admin must also be the leaving person, whatever their role, or an owner of an application the leaving person owns. The engine checks it.

rows.label: Request architecture review
rows.description: Please review this design. Default roles: Owner of the app, maker, architect, change-manager, platform-admin. A caller without the role maker or architect or change-manager or platform-admin must also be an owner of the subject application. The engine checks it.

rows.label: Complete review
rows.description: This review is done. Default roles: the person whose review it is. Served only to a person in the product's web app, never to an AI client. The engine checks the person leads the review, decides the decision it records or approves it, that the review is due, and that its outcome decision is accepted, of the type the review type records, about the review's application.

rows.label: Answer approval
rows.description: Approve or reject a request I was asked. Default roles: The person the approval request asks, through any role. Served only to a person in the product's web app, never to an AI client (D-38). The engine checks the person holds the role or owner role the request asks for, now, that no separation rule keeps the answer from counting, and that the request is pending and not expired.

rows.label: Record deployment correction
rows.description: That deployment belongs to this change, or a fact was wrong. Default roles: Owner of the app, maker, change-manager, platform-admin. A caller without the role maker or change-manager or platform-admin must also be an owner of the subject application. The engine checks it.

rows.label: Run owner check
rows.description: Which owners are disabled, deleted or leaving. Default roles: platform-admin.

rows.label: Explain rules
rows.description: Which rule applied to this record, and why. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Get configuration health
rows.description: Which versions exist, which drafts wait, and does the configuration load. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Get decision
rows.description: What is this decision, and who still has to answer. Default roles: Any role. Rows follow the read visibility settings (intake-visibility hides other people's intake requests); hidden rows are counted in couldNotRead.

rows.label: List approvals
rows.description: Which approval requests wait for me, or for others. Default roles: Any role. Rows follow the read visibility settings (intake-visibility hides other people's intake requests); hidden rows are counted in couldNotRead.

rows.label: List intake requests
rows.description: Which intake requests wait for triage, and what is the demand. Default roles: Any role. Rows follow the read visibility settings (intake-visibility hides other people's intake requests); hidden rows are counted in couldNotRead.

rows.label: Get intake request
rows.description: Where is this intake request. Default roles: Any role. Rows follow the read visibility settings (intake-visibility hides other people's intake requests); hidden rows are counted in couldNotRead.

rows.label: Score intake request
rows.description: Record the PMO's demand fields on a request on the table: score, size band, horizon, expected benefit. Default roles: pmo, platform-admin. Priority is a decision, proposed with save_decision_proposal.

rows.label: List reviews
rows.description: Which reviews are overdue, due or done. Default roles: Any role. Rows follow the read visibility settings (intake-visibility hides other people's intake requests); hidden rows are counted in couldNotRead.

rows.label: Get review
rows.description: Where is this review, and what does it need. Default roles: Any role. The review, its evidence, its outcome decision, its cadence, the gates it feeds, and whether the caller may complete it.

rows.label: List portfolios
rows.description: Which portfolios exist, and how do they look. Default roles: Any role. Rows follow the read visibility settings (intake-visibility hides other people's intake requests); hidden rows are counted in couldNotRead.

rows.label: List owner assignments
rows.description: Who owns what across the portfolio. Default roles: Any role. Leave dates and the leavers filter are for platform-admin only, as run_owner_check; anyone else sees only their own leave date. Rows follow the read visibility settings (intake-visibility hides other people's intake requests); hidden rows are counted in couldNotRead.

rows.label: Get audit trail
rows.description: What happened to this record, or what did this person do. Default roles: platform-admin, auditor. The product's audit entries: composed calls, refused calls, approval answers, acceptances and their effects.

rows.label: Get evidence
rows.description: What is the evidence for this application or this decision. Default roles: Any role. Decisions with every approval answer, changes, deployments with flags, reviews, documents and evidence links, each with the configuration version stamped on it.

rows.label: Get AI activity
rows.description: What did AI clients do, and who decided. Default roles: Any role. The estate for the AI lead, the security reviewer, the platform admin and the auditor; the AI work done for the caller for anyone else.

rows.label: Get tier assessment
rows.description: Why is this tier, and what does it need. Default roles: Any role. The latest tier answers with the driving answer, the Microsoft vocabulary and what the tier needs.

rows.label: Save dependency
rows.description: This app depends on that one; that dependency ended. Default roles: Owner of the app, architect, platform-admin. A caller without the role architect or platform-admin must also be an owner of the depending application. The engine checks it.

rows.label: Save portfolio
rows.description: Create or change a portfolio. Default roles: platform-admin, pmo. Served only to a person in the product's web app, never to an AI client. The platform admin creates, moves, names the accountable person and retires; the PMO edits the name, description and level.

rows.label: List deployment targets
rows.description: Where do deployments land, and what runs there. Default roles: Any role. External IDs and URLs are hidden from a caller who holds only the reader role.

rows.label: Save deployment target
rows.description: Register this place deployments land, or change it. Default roles: platform-admin. Served only to a person in the product's web app, never to an AI client: the stage and change path decide which rules apply.

rows.label: List documents
rows.description: Which documents are missing, stale or waiting across the portfolio. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: List gap check runs
rows.description: When was the gap check run, by whom, and what did it find. Default roles: maker, application-owner, ai-lead, pmo, platform-admin, auditor. claim-visibility can keep the runs to the platform admin, the AI lead and the auditor.

rows.label: Find data domains
rows.description: Which data domains match, and who owns them?. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Get data domain
rows.description: Everything about one data domain: owners up the chain, rules and their source, mappings, uses, decisions, outside matches, gaps. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Find data locations
rows.description: Which stores match a platform, stage, parent, text, unmapped or stale? With a locationId, the full detail of one. Default roles: Any role. External IDs and URLs are restricted read. External IDs and URLs are restricted read: null for a caller who holds only the reader role.

rows.label: Resolve data
rows.description: Which data is this table, object or file?. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Check data use
rows.description: May this app use this data this way, and what is needed?. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Get data gaps
rows.description: What is missing, broken or waiting in the data?. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Save data use
rows.description: This app reads or writes this data, or it stopped. Default roles: Owner of the app, maker, application-owner, platform-admin. A caller without the role maker or platform-admin must also be an owner of the application. An AI client's use stays a draft, and its decision is proposed, never sent. The engine refuses a use whose rule is never, for everyone (G-25).

rows.label: Save data location
rows.description: This store exists, moved, or is gone (up to 100 items per call). Default roles: platform-admin, architect, application-owner, the location's technical owner, data-governance-lead. Changing a registered location also needs the role platform-admin, architect or data-governance-lead, or the technical owner role on the location. An AI client's location stays a draft.

rows.label: Save data mapping
rows.description: This domain's data sits here, or it left. Default roles: The location's technical owner, the domain's effective owner or steward, platform-admin, data-governance-lead. A caller without the role platform-admin or data-governance-lead must be the domain's effective data owner or steward, or the location's technical owner. An AI client never sends a copy decision.

rows.label: Move data references
rows.description: Move mappings and uses off a domain. Default roles: platform-admin, data-governance-lead. An AI client may preview with validateOnly.

rows.label: Run due-state refresh
rows.description: Run the daily due-state refresh now. Default roles: platform-admin. Served only to a person in the product's web app, never to an AI client. The engine runs the same refresh every day on its own.

rows.label: List configuration changes
rows.description: Which configuration versions exist, who accepted each and when, and which drafts wait. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Get configuration draft
rows.description: What a configuration draft changes, whether it is valid, and what it touches. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Get role access
rows.description: Who holds each role, through which group, and what each role may do. Default roles: Any role. The holders are read live from Entra as the person.

rows.label: List guidelines
rows.description: Why each rule exists: the guidelines, the playbook chapters, the builder paths and the sanctioned clients. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Get measures
rows.description: The measures and slide-back signals with the rows behind them. Default roles: Any role. Intakes the caller may not read are left out and counted.

rows.label: Get admin status
rows.description: How the product is running: host settings, Tool Policy, clients, notices and the outbox. Default roles: platform-admin, configuration-admin, auditor. Only the platform admin and the auditor see the notices listed.

rows.label: List agents
rows.description: Which agents exist, and whether each is decided, reviewed, owned and ready to go live. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Request security review
rows.description: Please review the security of this agent or app. Default roles: Owner of the app, ai-lead, security-reviewer, architect, platform-admin. A caller without the role ai-lead or security-reviewer or architect or platform-admin must also be an owner of the subject application. The engine checks it.

rows.label: List data uses
rows.description: The data uses across every domain, each with its decision state, computed when read; one use by its ID. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: List data mappings
rows.description: The data mappings across every domain, with the copy state of each copy outside production; one mapping by its ID. Default roles: Any role.

rows.label: Import data taxonomy
rows.description: Turn this CSV or catalog list into a configuration draft of data domains. Default roles: configuration-admin. The draft is a candidate: nothing is in force until a person accepts its decision.

rows.label: Renew approval request
rows.description: Ask an expired approval request again. Default roles: The proposer of the decision, or a platform admin, through any role. Served only to a person in the product's web app, never to an AI client. The engine checks the person, the decision and the request.

rows.label: Retry approval card
rows.description: Send a stuck approval card again. Default roles: platform-admin. Served only to a person in the product's web app, never to an AI client.

rows.label: Get demo freshness
rows.description: Is the demo fresh, or has a story approval request expired? Default roles: Any role. Served only on a demo install.
